issues.title: Local models answer tool calls in content and the call is dropped

criteria.requirement: A tool call written into content is executed, in the Llama 3.x form, the Qwen function form with or without a closing tag, the Qwen per-parameter form, and the documented JSON form.

tests.name: reads the Llama 3.x tool_call block
reads a closed Qwen tag with arguments
reads the unterminated Qwen tag a truncated reply ends on
reads the per-parameter XML form qwen3-coder uses
reads the documented tool JSON block after some prose
survives malformed JSON where arguments were expected
Ollama: tool call in content with null tool_calls
OpenAI-compatible: tool call in content only

criteria.requirement: A structured tool_calls channel still wins over content when both are present.

tests.name: Ollama: structured tool_calls still win over content

criteria.requirement: A tool name outside the advertised tool list is dropped, never dispatched.

tests.name: drops an invented tool name
drops an invented name in the Llama block
drops a per-parameter call naming an unknown tool
does not dispatch an unclosed tag sitting mid-prose
rejects a tool JSON line naming an unknown tool
kToolNames matches the advertised tool list

criteria.requirement: Tool-call markup no claimed pattern strips out of the spoken text, including a call that was recognised by shape but rejected by name.

tests.name: strips a stray tool_call tag left in the prose
strips a rejected call out of the prose it was found in
strips a rejected per-parameter call from the prose
strips a rejected Llama block out of the prose
still finds a real call after a rejected one
keeps prose on either side of a rejected call readable
leaves an ordinary reply untouched

criteria.requirement: dart format lib test, flutter analyze, and flutter test are clean, and a test covers each accepted encoding, a rejected name, and the structured-channel precedence.
criteria.reason: The required CI lanes run on the PR; a local toolchain below the pinned Dart SDK cannot resolve dependencies to reproduce the gate.
